run_policy: one candidate invocation followed once by one independent raw-only auditor invocation; preserve the first outcome and do not retry or tune
H: On fixed-position synthetic three-landmark views, the spherical feature controller reaches the same exact terminal-view criterion with no greater target-loss/action-bound violation rate than raw normalized coordinates and reduces median corrections by at least 20% on the 60 rotation-only/combined pairs. Focal shift and feature-loss strata are separate limits/stress reports.

D.method_pass: all 120 paired fixtures and 360 arm trials complete; source/frame/event custody and independent replay have zero errors; source/order/stale-generation/missing-release/forged-feature mutations are all rejected; all eight invalid feature-loss controls abstain for both image arms (54 trials); radial range null preserves its projection; actions stay inside the envelope and every synthetic trial has a neutral release receipt
D.h_supported: method_pass and spherical terminal successes >= raw successes on primary pairs, target loss <= raw target loss, and >=0.20 median correction reduction
D.h_fail: valid audited method run but quantitative hypothesis gate not met
D.hold: invalid/missing inputs, integrity or oracle mismatch

runtime.mode: local single-process CPU-only CPython; no container, Docker/OrbStack, WSL, GUI, OS input, model, GPU, shared VM, or external effect
